title: Ticket HD-27-04471: Locum Anesthesiologist Locked Out

fields.requester: Dr. R. Okonkwo-Lind – Visiting Locum Anesthesiologist, Surgical Services
fields.subject: Locum anesthesiologist locked out of network account – needs reset before 07:30 OR list
fields.description: Visiting locum anesthesiologist Dr. R. Okonkwo-Lind, here for the 07:30 OR list, says her network account is locked after 'several' failed logins from the OR workroom PC. She is asking for an immediate reset so she can review pre-op notes in the downtime viewer. She says she never got her welcome email.

activity.author: IS Help Desk – night technician
activity.text: Another weird login tonight? Should I loop in security?

activity.author: IS Help Desk – night technician
activity.text: Dr. Okonkwo-Lind, we have your request. Before we reset a locked account we have to verify your identity through the standard process. Please stay on ext. 5718 and we will call you back. Lakechart is still in downtime, so pre-op notes are available only in the read-only downtime viewer (data current as of 23:20).

activity.author: System
activity.text: Ticket created via phone (IS Help Desk, ext. 5500). Priority set to High: start time 07:30 on the OR list. Directory status for the requester's account: LOCKED OUT, threshold reached at 05:08.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. A locum who never got her welcome email and is now locked out during an outage is routine. Watch for the Clinical Systems Lead to send it through the normal identity check, and for Security to log it without linking it to the svc-rptexport alert (NSM-27-00562) unless there is evidence. Note it if either role pulls Ananya Desai or other restore analysts off the array problem to chase it.
